rows.text: In the Lok Sabha on 15 July 1996 Shri Sriballav Panigrahi (Deogarh), speaking in English, quoted 'the Janata Dal Supremo, the Bihar Chief Minister Shri Laloo Prasad Yadav' and said: 'The Janata Dal Party Supremo, the party President, the Bihar Chief Minister had taken the Prime Minister to task. Shri Laloo Prasad Yadav issued this statement before coming to attend the Chief Minister's Conference.'
